min_supported_version.description: Builds below this version are blocked with a dialog that cannot be dismissed. Leave empty to block nobody.

latest_version.description: The newest released version. Builds below it get a dismissible update prompt.

update_message.description: Shown instead of the built-in text. Use it to spell out why an update is urgent.

store_url_android.description: Where the Update button sends Android users.

store_url_ios.description: App Store link. Empty until the app has an App Store id; the button stays hidden until then.
